environment.description: EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running this CLI tool as part of a batch processing pipeline. The tool is invoked by a Lambda-triggered SSM RunCommand with config files sourced from an S3 bucket that accepts uploads from multiple internal teams. Instance role has s3:*, ec2:*, iam:GetRole, iam:PassRole permissions. No IMDSv2 enforcement. Security groups allow outbound to 0.0.0.0/0.

config.binary_protections: compiled without stack canaries, no ASLR on this AMI
